A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''commander''' was present on the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. After [[Ganner Rhysode]] barricaded himself in the entrance to the [[Well of the World Brain]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was approached by [[Nom Anor]], who wanted the [[Warrior caste|warrior]] to gas or blow Rhysode up to get past him. However, the commander refused to do such a dishonorable deed.
